findings.element: Client details › Work tab › Synder evidence › Connections
findings.finding: The month close evidence states the client has no accounting connection and that close checks do not apply, while the org has QuickBooks Online connected with status Connection lost and the same panel reports 12 failed syncs in the period.
findings.user_impact: An admin closing the month is told sync evidence is irrelevant exactly when the books are missing transactions (lost connection, 12 failed syncs), so the period gets closed on incomplete books.
findings.suggested_fix: Detect the existing accounting company connection and show its real state ("QuickBooks Online · Connection lost" with Reconnect), keeping failed syncs as close-blocking evidence instead of declaring the checks not applicable.

evidence.quote: The client has no accounting connection in Synder, so its month close checks do not apply.
evidence.source: Accounting rule: a period must not be closed while source transactions have not posted to the ledger; vocabulary.md: the software is the "Accounting company" (QuickBooks Online), not "accounting connection"

findings.finding: The client Billing tab shows "No data" for both clients although each organization has an active Pro, yearly subscription (one with a Payer user, one canceled but active till 05 Aug 2027).
findings.user_impact: The firm cannot tell which clients it pays for versus which pay Synder directly, so it cannot rebill clients or accrue the subscription cost correctly per client.
findings.suggested_fix: Populate the row from the organization's subscription (plan, billing period, renewal or end date, payer) and label the tab Pricing per vocabulary.md.

evidence.source: vocabulary.md Organization: "has accounting company + integrations + subscription plan"; vocabulary.md UI words: "Pricing" not "billing"

findings.element: Firm › Billing and licenses tab copy
findings.finding: The tab describes a fixed fee per client while the org switcher promises a volume discount, and neither claim is backed by any figure, tier, client list or invoice on the screen (unsourced product logic).
findings.user_impact: A firm admin cannot determine what the firm owes or which discount tier applies, so firm-side cost per client cannot be reconciled to Synder invoices.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the firm's billed clients, current tier and discount, per-client fee and invoices, and state one pricing model consistently; mark the claims unverified until sourced.

evidence.quote: Licenses give you access to unlimited integrations, syncs, rules, a dedicated Synder Specialist, and more at a fixed fee per client.
evidence.source: Unsourced product logic rule; conflicts with "Connect more clients to get a discount." and public partner tiers Silver -10% / Gold -15% / Platinum -20%
